# Draft:3Dsurvey software

----
3Dsurvey is a proprietary photogrammetry and geospatial data-processing software developed by the Slovenian company 3Dsurvey d.o.o. It is designed to process data from drones, terrestrial imagery, LiDAR/scan, and other geospatial sources to generate orthophotos, terrain and surface models, point clouds, 3D meshes, and CAD-ready outputs.
Overview
* 3Dsurvey is intended for professionals in surveying, construction, mining, infrastructure, environmental management, archaeology, and related fields.
* The software aims to provide an “all-in-one” workflow: from raw data capture through processing to deliverables such as orthophotos, 3D models, terrain maps, CAD plans, and volume calculations — reducing the need to switch between multiple specialized tools.
* According to its developers, more than half of the team at 3Dsurvey are trained surveyors, which the company claims helps align the tool with real-world surveying needs.
Key features
According to recent reporting and company-published material, 3Dsurvey supports the following:
* Multi-data-source support: The software can ingest aerial drone images, terrestrial photographs, LiDAR point clouds, SLAM/scan data, GNSS/GPS ground control data, video (for videogrammetry), and more.
* Orthophoto, point cloud, terrain and mesh generation: From the imported data, 3Dsurvey can produce high-resolution orthophotos, digital terrain models (DTM/DSM), dense point clouds, textured 3D meshes, and orthometric outputs suitable for mapping, surveying and visualization.
* CAD and surveying tools: The software includes an integrated CAD engine, enabling tasks such as volume calculations, contour line generation, cross-sections, topographic plans, vector outputs (e.g. DXF), and drawing planes — all within the same environment.
* Data integration and georeferencing: The 3.0 release notably improved coordinate system handling and georeferencing capabilities, including support for global coordinate systems, grid file transformations, geoid models, and PRJ-file standard formats — reducing the need for additional GIS software for coordinate transformations.
* Scan module: For merging point clouds or scan datasets from varying sources (e.g. terrestrial LiDAR + UAV), 3Dsurvey offers both manual and automatic registration tools to align different scans.
* Videogrammetry module & mobile data capture: The software supports videogrammetry workflows, e.g. using smartphone-recorded geopositioned video (in some cases with RTK antenna) to derive point clouds and 3D reconstructions, enabling quick data capture for small or hard-to-access sites.
* Export functionality: Outputs (orthophotos, DEM/DSM, point clouds, meshes, CAD drawings, volume reports, etc.) can be exported in standard file formats compatible with GIS, CAD, BIM, and other external software systems.
Use in industry
An example of industry adoption was in 2024, when the Finnish infrastructure company Destia, among the largest in its country, publicly announced that it selected 3Dsurvey software for 3D modelling and surveying tasks, citing its CAD functionality and comprehensive photogrammetry features as critical for complex engineering projects.
